techStack: Runtime: Node.js + TypeScript (~6.0.2), ES2023 target, ESNext modules
HTTP framework: Express 5 with CORS middleware
Dev runtime: tsx with hot reload; build output to dist/ via tsconfig.build.json
Test runner: Vitest 4 (globals: true) + Supertest; pnpm test runs vitest run
TypeScript strict: noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch, erasableSyntaxOnly — all enabled; verbatimModuleSyntax enabled
Package manager: pnpm; no ESLint or Prettier configs present
features: GET /products currently supports: search, category, inStock, sort (price_asc, price_desc, name_asc, name_desc), page, limit
VALID_SORT_OPTIONS currently contains only: price_asc, price_desc, name_asc, name_desc — rating_desc is absent (marked TODO in queryParser.ts)
Product interface already declares featured?: boolean and rating: number; ProductQuery already declares featured?: boolean; SortOption already includes 'rating_desc'
15 products in products.ts across 5 categories; no product currently has the featured field set

Product ids by category: electronics (1 Laptop, 2 Smartphone, 3 Wireless Headphones, 4 Mechanical Keyboard), clothing (5, 6, 7), furniture (8 Ergonomic Chair, 9, 10), sports (11 Yoga Mat, 12, 13), books (14 Clean Code, 15)
Test file already has 'Featured filter' suite (3 tests) and 'Rating sort' suite (1 test) — these are the new passing targets
architecture: Layer flow: Routes (productRoutes.ts) → Controller (productController.ts) → Utils (queryParser.ts) + Service (productService.ts) → Data (products.ts) + Types (product.ts)

Query parsing: controller calls parseProductQuery(req.query), which validates and converts strings to typed ProductQuery; inStock already parsed as boolean via === 'true' / === 'false' pattern — featured must follow same pattern
Service filtering: getAllProducts applies search → category → inStock filters in sequence by reassigning result; featured filter slots after inStock (line 21 TODO in productService.ts)
Service sorting: if/else chain with explicit sort cases; each creates fresh copy via [...result].sort(); rating_desc slots as final else-if after name_desc (line 34 TODO in productService.ts)
Return shape: PaginatedResponse<Product> with data, total, page, limit, totalPages fields
edgeCases: featured field absent on a product: expression (p.featured ?? false) === query.featured correctly treats undefined as false — absent-field products appear in featured=false results and are excluded from featured=true results
featured param absent: query.featured remains undefined; guard (query.featured !== undefined) before filter ensures no filtering applied — all 15 products returned unfiltered (requirement 8)
featured param values other than 'true'/'false' (e.g. '1', 'yes', absent): must leave query.featured unset — mirror exact inStock parsing logic, strict string equality only
featured=true + category=electronics must return exactly 1 product (id 1, Laptop) — only 1 of the 4 featured products is in the electronics category
Array mutation risk: all existing sorts use [...result].sort(); rating_desc must follow the same copy pattern — in-place sort would cause non-deterministic failures across test runs (requirement 9)
Total product count invariant: exactly 4 products must have featured: true; remaining 11 must not — test asserts both counts precisely
Products sharing the same rating: test only checks non-increasing property, not strict order between ties — stable sort between equals is not required
